faqs.a:
The lien provided in the preceding section may be foreclosed by seizing under distraint
               warrant and selling so much of the property covered by the lien as may be necessary
               to discharge said lien. Such distraint warrant may be issued by the finance director
               whenever the taxpayer or vendor is in default in the payment of sales or use tax,
               interest and penalty, and may be served and the goods subject to such lien seized
               and sold by any employee of the finance department or any police officer.
(Code 1981, § 31-66; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
